name: blackswan-tsmom
description: The TIME-SERIES MOMENTUM / trend-following probe — the flagship of the published-anomaly battery and the most-defended free edge (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012; the whole managed-futures / CTA industry). Unlike the cross-sectional line ("will A beat B?") this asks the time-series question ("is THIS market trending?") and takes an ABSOLUTE long/short book: each asset in a survivorship-free diversified basket (7 commodities + SPY + TLT + IEF + UUP, daily from 2006) is LONG when its trailing-lookback return is positive and SHORT when negative (trend), or the exact sign-negation (trend_inverse, the mirror control), sized inverse-vol (risk parity) or equal-notional, rebalanced monthly and held between. The whole portfolio is one equity curve; the trend sign is computed from past-only trailing return + past-only vol, applied on the NEXT bar (never on its own bar), turnover-costed. There is no natural buy-and-hold benchmark for a directional trend book, so the decider is the DSR-deflated oos_sharpe across a MAJORITY of the deep-history windows. Deterministic and model-free (seed is contract-only). PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION: refutation net of cost OOS (trend following endured a long post-2011 drawdown; public rules decay — McLean-Pontiff 2016); a survivor across a majority of 2008-2024 windows would be the program's first cost-surviving edge. DATA: commodities/<SYM>-1d-*.json + etfs/<SYM>-1d-*.json.

universe.description: The survivorship-free trend basket. diversified = GOLD/SILVER/COPPER/WTI/NATGAS/CORN/WHEAT + SPY/TLT/IEF/UUP (commodities + equity + rates + dollar proxy), the diversified futures-like set Moskowitz's test rests on. commodities / financials are the sub-baskets.

signal.description: trend = long the up-trenders / short the down-trenders (the published rule); trend_inverse = the exact sign negation (mirror control, pre-registered so the winning direction cannot be cherry-picked). An unknown value is refused.

weight_scheme.description: invvol sizes each held leg inverse to its past-only trailing vol (Moskowitz risk parity); equal sizes every leg the same notional. Both normalise to unit gross, so the leverage-free curve's Sharpe is unaffected by the choice.

lookback.description: The trailing formation window (bars) whose SIGN sets each asset's direction. 252 ~ 12 months (the canonical TSMOM horizon); 126 ~ 6m, 63 ~ 3m. A non-positive lookback is refused (it ratios against a bar that has not happened).

rebalance_days.description: How often (bars) the book is re-decided; between rebalances it is held. 21 ~ monthly, the canonical TSMOM rebalance.

vol_span.description: The trailing window (bars) for the past-only volatility estimate used by the invvol scheme. Ignored under equal weighting.

transaction_fee.description: Per-side fee charged on the daily turnover of the trend book (~0.1% round trip per unit of weight change) — realistic for liquid futures/ETFs.

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample year is ACCOUNTED. A real trend edge must clear DSR-deflated oos_sharpe in a MAJORITY of these 17 regime-diverse years (the GFC, 2011, 2015-16, 2018, 2020), not one lucky period.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the backtest is fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept.
